predicted_reason: The aluminum business cards and table signs are classified under heading 8479, which covers electrical machinery and equipment, and parts thereof; parts for machinery of heading 8501 to 8541. The table signs are also classified under heading 8542, which covers other electrical machinery and equipment. The laser-ablation and sublimation printing processes used for the business cards indicate they are considered as made-up articles, thus they fall under the provision for 'other made-up clothing articles' in heading 6104.
